The '''Cyberlegs Mod II''' was a model of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|legs]] made by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]], the leading manufacturer in cybernetic body parts. The limbs were designed to replace legs lost in an accident, but also provided greater power than most organic legs. The legs were available for 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="EOTEC" /> as a pair, and could not be purchased singularly. They were available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cyberlegs Mod II was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Sterling Hershey]].
